pagination.summary: Total: {total, number} · Page {page, number} of {pages, number}

onboarding.title: Add your company
onboarding.description: All orders, products and connections will belong to this company.
onboarding.name: Company name

errors.userExists: An account with this email already exists.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: You will find products, orders and connections in the menu above.
dashboard.eventsDescription: The test job goes through the queue and the worker, and its result shows up here.
dashboard.eventsEmpty: No events yet. Send a test job to check that the worker is running.

products.title: Products
products.empty: There are no products yet. Add the first one, or create them from offers pulled from a channel.

detail.title: Product
detail.shortage: Shortage: more was sold than is in stock.
detail.dataDescription: The SKU is fixed and cannot be changed.
detail.name: Name
detail.stockDescription: Hanza is the source of truth for stock. Set it per warehouse. A line of an order is never split between warehouses, so each channel is told the most that one of its warehouses can cover (and never more than all of them together), less its safety buffer, and at most its channel limit.
detail.stockSaved: Saved. The new stock will be sent to the channels.
detail.priceDescription: Hanza owns prices. The base price goes to every linked offer without a price of its own, wherever the channel sells in the same currency. Without a base price, nothing is sent.
detail.offersEmpty: This product has no linked offers yet. An offer is linked automatically by SKU, or manually in the list of offers without a product.
detail.unlinkConfirm: Unlink the offer from this product? The channel will no longer receive its stock.
detail.reservationsDescription: Goods promised to orders that have not been shipped yet.

new.title: Add product
new.skuHint: Unique within the company; it cannot be changed later.
new.name: Name

families.title: Product families
families.intro: A family groups the products that are sizes or colours of one another. Orders, stock and offers keep working on the individual products.
families.empty: There are no product families yet. Create one to group products such as sizes or colours.

new.title: Add family
new.name: Name
new.attributesHint: What tells the products apart, separated by commas, for example: Size, Colour. At most 5; they cannot be changed later.

detail.title: Product family
detail.renameDescription: The name is only for you; channels do not see it.
detail.name: Name
detail.membersDescription: Each product has one value per attribute. No two products can have the same values.
detail.membersEmpty: No products in this family yet. Add the first one below.
detail.removeConfirm: Remove this product from the family? The product itself stays as it is.
detail.addDescription: A product can be in one family at a time.
detail.skuHint: The SKU of an existing product that is in no family.
detail.deleteDescription: Its products are not deleted: they just stop being grouped. Orders, stock and offers are not affected.
detail.deleteConfirm: Delete this family? Its products stay, ungrouped.

offers.title: Offers without a product
offers.description: Offers pulled from channels whose SKU does not match any product.
offers.createDescription: Select the offers that have a SKU in the table. A product gets the offer's SKU and name and a stock of 0. It gets no price: set one on the product, and only then is it sent to the channels.

skipReasons.sku_taken: a product with this SKU already exists

offers.empty: Every offer has a product. New offers will appear after a connection syncs.
offers.selectAll: Select all offers with a SKU
offers.linkSkuLabel: SKU of the product to link the offer to

offerDetail.title: Offer
offerDetail.channelPriceHint: As reported at the last sync. Hanza does not take it over.
offerDetail.overrideDescription: A price for this offer only. It wins over the product's base price; remove it to go back to the base price.
offerDetail.mismatchHint: Set an offer price in {currency} to send one.
offerDetail.notLinked: This offer is not linked to a product, so Hanza sends neither its stock nor its price. Link it on the list of offers without a product.
offerDetail.publicationHint: As reported at the last sync or stock push.
offerDetail.stockDescription: Hanza sends the number the channel may sell. If the channel refuses this offer, the other offers keep syncing; retry once the cause is fixed. A change of stock or stock settings retries it on its own.
offerDetail.priceRetryDescription: If the channel refuses this offer's price, retry once the cause is fixed. A new price retries it on its own.

form.saved: Saved. The channels will receive the new price shortly.

status.not_linked: Not sent: the offer is not linked to a product.
status.unsupported: Not sent: this channel's connector cannot set prices.
status.no_price: No price, so nothing is sent.
status.currency_unknown: Not sent: the channel did not report the offer's currency.
status.currency_mismatch: Not sent: the channel sells this offer in {channelCurrency} and the price is in {priceCurrency}.

orders.title: Orders
orders.empty: There are no orders yet. They will appear after a connection syncs with a channel.

detail.title: Order
detail.attentionHint: Link the unmatched lines to products below and Needs attention clears on its own.
detail.statusDescription: Hanza leads the fulfilment. Moving the order to another phase is passed on to the channel if the channel supports it; statuses within one phase are your own labels and stay in Hanza.
detail.awaitingPaymentHint: The buyer has not paid yet. The goods stay reserved; the order can be fulfilled once the channel reports the payment, and until then it can only be cancelled or given another status of the New phase.
detail.awaitingPaymentShippedHint: Shipped, but the channel has not reported the payment for this order.
detail.finalStatus: The order is in a final phase ({status}) and has no other status to move to.
detail.confirmShipped: Mark the order as shipped? The reserved goods will be taken off stock.
detail.confirmCancelled: Cancel the order? The reservations will be released and this cannot be undone.
detail.buyerUnreadable: The buyer data of this order cannot be read: it does not decrypt with the current encryption key, or it is damaged.
detail.factsEmpty: The channel has not reported any changes.

linkLine.skuLabel: SKU of the product to link the line to

moveReservation.label: Move the reservation to
moveReservation.hint: Only to a warehouse that has enough available for the whole line.

connections.title: Connections
connections.empty: There are no connections yet. Add a connection to a channel to pull offers and orders.

detail.title: Connection
detail.syncDescription: Hanza synchronises the connection in the background. The request goes to the queue and the results appear here shortly: refresh the page.
detail.syncRequested: Synchronisation requested. Refresh the page in a moment.

statusMapping.title: Order statuses from this channel
statusMapping.description: Which of your statuses an order of this channel gets when the channel reports it. Orders already imported keep their status.
statusMapping.adminsOnly: Only an owner or admin of the organization can change this.

detail.rejectedDescription: The channel refused the last stock or price of these offers. The other offers keep syncing. Open an offer to see why and to retry.
detail.authExpired: {connector} no longer accepts the sign-in of this connection, so it does not sync. Sign in again to resume.

new.title: Add connection
new.description: Choose the connector Hanza will use to reach the channel.
new.name: Name
new.nameHint: The connection will appear in the panel under this name.
new.credentialsNote: We store them encrypted and never show them again.
new.notConfigured: Not set up on this installation
new.notConfiguredHint: Whoever runs this Hanza sets these variables and restarts it: {variables}
new.signInNote: Next you get a code to confirm on {connector}. Hanza never sees your password there.

stockRules.title: Stock sent to this channel
stockRules.description: The channel is told the most that one of the warehouses it counts (below) can cover, less the safety buffer, and never more than the channel limit. Orders reserve against Available, not against this number.
stockRules.safetyBufferHint: Units held back from this channel, for example to keep the last units for your shop.
stockRules.channelLimitHint: The most units this channel is told. Leave empty for no limit.
stockRules.saved: Saved. The new numbers will be sent to this channel.

warehouses.title: Warehouses counted for this channel
warehouses.description: The channel is told what one of these warehouses can cover, since a line is never split: the largest Available among them, and never more than their total. Its orders reserve in them: in the first one, by priority, that can cover the whole line. A line none of them can cover is a shortage, even if another warehouse has the goods.
warehouses.saved: Saved. The new numbers will be sent to this channel.

signIn.title: Sign in to {connector}
signIn.instructions: Open the sign-in page of {connector}, enter this code and allow access for Hanza.
signIn.noLink: Go to the sign-in page of {connector} and enter the code there.
signIn.waiting: Waiting for your approval. This page updates by itself.
signIn.expired: The code expired before it was approved.
signIn.failed: The sign-in failed. Try again in a moment.
signIn.account_mismatch: You signed in as {account}, a different {connector} account than this connection uses. Sign in with the account the connection was set up with, or add a new connection.
signIn.account_mismatch_unknown: This connection is bound to another {connector} account, and {connector} did not say which account approved. Sign in with the account the connection was set up with, or add a new connection.
signIn.account_in_use: The {connector} account {account} already has a connection here. Use “Sign in again” on that connection instead.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Buyer data on orders (names, contact details, addresses) is stored encrypted. Here you decide how long it is kept and handle a request to erase one person's data.
privacy.adminsOnly: Only an owner or admin of the organization can change the retention period or erase a buyer's data.

retention.title: Buyer data retention
retention.description: Buyer data is erased this many days after an order was shipped or cancelled. Order lines, amounts and the shipping country are kept. Open orders are never affected.
retention.label: Days after the order closed
retention.hint: From 1 to 3650 days. Leave empty to keep buyer data until you erase it. Orders that were already closed before Hanza recorded closing times count from their last change.
retention.saved: Saved. The check runs every hour.
retention.currentDays: Now: buyer data is erased {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after an order closed.
retention.currentOff: Now: buyer data is kept until you erase it.
retention.confirmCount: {count, plural, =0 {With {days, number} days, no order would have its buyer data erased at the next check.} one {With {days, number} days, # order will have its buyer data erased at the next check, within an hour. This cannot be undone.} other {With {days, number} days, # orders will have their buyer data erased at the next check, within an hour. This cannot be undone.}}
retention.confirm: Save and erase at the next check
retention.confirmDialog: Save the new retention period? Buyer data past it is erased within an hour and cannot be restored.

erasure.title: Erase a buyer's data
erasure.description: Finds this organization's orders placed with exactly this email address (letter case does not matter) and erases their buyer data. Orders for which the channel gave no email cannot be found this way.
erasure.noMatch: No order of this organization has buyer data with this email address.
erasure.previewClosed: {count, plural, =0 {No shipped or cancelled order to erase.} one {# shipped or cancelled order will have its buyer data erased.} other {# shipped or cancelled orders will have their buyer data erased.}}
erasure.openKept: {count, plural, one {# order is still open and is kept: its address is needed to ship it. Ship or cancel it, then erase again.} other {# orders are still open and are kept: their address is needed to ship them. Ship or cancel them, then erase again.}}
erasure.confirm: Erase the buyer data of these orders? This cannot be undone.
erasure.done: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing was erased.} one {Buyer data erased on # order.} other {Buyer data erased on # orders.}}

attentionReason.channel_fact_conflict: The channel reported a change after completion
attentionReason.status_push_failed: The channel refused the new status

result.updatesIgnored: changes to orders not in Hanza

events.ordersErased: {count, plural, one {# order erased} other {# orders erased}}
events.someWarehouses: {count, plural, one {# chosen warehouse} other {# chosen warehouses}}
events.feedRestartGap: orders placed and closed meanwhile may be missing
events.addresses: {which, select, shipping {shipping address} billing {billing address} other {shipping and billing address}}

domain.sku_taken: A product with this SKU already exists.
domain.invalid_transition: This status change is not allowed.
domain.awaiting_payment: The order is not paid yet. It can be fulfilled once the channel reports the payment.
domain.unmatched_lines: Link all the lines to products first.
domain.combination_taken: Another product in this family already has these values.
domain.invalid_attributes: Fill in every attribute (at most 100 characters) and keep the attribute names distinct.
domain.already_in_family: This product is already in a family. Remove it from there first.
domain.invalid_price: This price does not fit its currency: check the decimal places.
domain.not_a_channel: This connection is not a sales channel, so it has no stock settings.
domain.forbidden: Only an owner or admin of the organization can do this.
domain.status_is_default: A default status cannot be deactivated or deleted. Make another status the default first.
domain.status_in_use: This status is still used. Choose a status to move its orders to.
domain.invalid_replacement: Choose another active status of the same phase.
domain.status_name_taken: An active status with this name already exists.
domain.status_inactive: This status is inactive. Activate it first.
domain.status_name_required: Enter a name. Only a default status can go without one.
domain.status_is_replacement: Orders of a status being deleted are moving to this one. Try again when that deletion is done.
domain.warehouse_is_default: The default warehouse cannot be deactivated or deleted.
domain.warehouse_not_empty: The warehouse still holds stock or open reservations.
domain.warehouse_in_use: The warehouse is still in use: a channel chose it, or it has reservations in its history. Change the channel’s warehouses first, or deactivate it instead of deleting it.
domain.reservation_not_open: Only an open reservation of a new or processing order can be moved.
domain.not_enough_stock: That warehouse does not have enough available for the whole line.
domain.not_linked: This offer is not linked to a product.
domain.connector_not_configured: This connector is not set up on this installation yet. Ask whoever runs Hanza.
domain.sign_in_required: This connector is connected by signing in, not with a form.

errors.unknownSku: There is no product with this SKU.

validation.skuTooLong: The SKU can have at most 64 characters.
validation.unitsInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 1,000,000.
validation.productNameTooLong: The name can have at most 200 characters.
validation.connectionNameTooLong: The name can have at most 100 characters.
validation.offersTooMany: Select at most 200 offers at a time.
validation.statusNameTooLong: The name can have at most 60 characters.
validation.colorInvalid: Choose a colour from the list.
validation.statusNameReserved: This is the name of a phase. Leave the name of the default status empty to use it.
validation.familyNameTooLong: The name can have at most 100 characters.
validation.attributesInvalid: Enter 1 to 5 different attribute names, each at most 50 characters, separated by commas.
validation.attributeValueRequired: Enter a value of at most 100 characters.
validation.priceAmbiguous: Ambiguous: three digits after the separator. Write 1234 for a thousands amount, or use fewer decimal places.
validation.priceTooManyDecimals: Too many decimal places for this currency (PLN has 2, JPY none).
validation.currencyInvalid: Enter a three-letter currency code, e.g. PLN.
validation.emailInvalid: Enter an email address (with @, at most 320 characters).
validation.retentionDaysInvalid: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to 3650, or leave the field empty.
validation.warehouseNameTooLong: The name can have at most 100 characters.

orderStatuses.title: Order statuses
orderStatuses.description: Your own statuses for the order workflow. Each one belongs to a phase: Hanza keeps stock and channels in step by the phase, and the status is your finer label within it.
orderStatuses.adminsOnly: Only an owner or admin of the organization can change the order statuses.

phaseHint.new: Orders arrive here from the channels. Stock is reserved.
phaseHint.shipped: Final: the reserved goods have been taken off stock.
phaseHint.cancelled: Final: the reservations have been released.

orderStatuses.name: Name
orderStatuses.nameHint: Empty (default status only): the phase name, in each person’s language.
orderStatuses.replacementFor: Status the orders of {status} move to
orderStatuses.confirmDeleteMoving: Delete the status {status} and move its orders to the chosen status?
orderStatuses.usedByChannels: {count, plural, one {Used by # channel} other {Used by # channels}}
orderStatuses.defaultHint: The status an order gets when it enters this phase, unless a channel says otherwise. It cannot be deactivated or deleted.
orderStatuses.deleteScheduled: Deleting: its orders are being moved to the chosen status. The status disappears when that is done.
orderStatuses.deletionInProgress: Being deleted: its orders are moving to {status}.

warehouses.title: Warehouses
warehouses.description: Places where your stock is kept. Each line of a new order is reserved in the first warehouse, by priority, that can cover it in full. On a connection page you can limit a channel to some warehouses.
warehouses.newDescription: A new warehouse starts empty and active. Channels that count all warehouses count it at once.
warehouses.name: Name
warehouses.priorityHint: Lower numbers are used first. Leave empty to put it last.
warehouses.priorityHintEdit: Lower numbers are used first when an order is reserved.

detail.title: Warehouse
detail.statusActive: Active: it can hold stock and receive reservations.
detail.statusInactive: Inactive: it holds nothing and counts for no channel.
detail.deactivateHint: Only an empty warehouse can be deactivated: no stock, no open reservations, and no channel that chose it.
detail.deleteConfirm: Delete this warehouse? This cannot be undone.
detail.deleteHint: A warehouse that has ever had a reservation can only be deactivated.
detail.defaultNote: This is the default warehouse: new products get their initial stock here. It is always active and cannot be deleted.

offerPush.offerEnded: Not sent: the offer has ended on the channel. Hanza reopens only offers that sold out; reactivate it on the channel to sell it again.

stock.not_linked: Not sent: the offer is not linked to a product.
stock.not_sent: Not sent: the offer has ended on the channel, and there is no stock to reopen it with.
stock.pushed: {count, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} sent {date}.
